"Aldebaran"

As noted in Destry's excellent Astronomy guide (tinyurl.com/oudekoy), this Astronomical discovery can be found in the Adriatic Sea at sunset/night during 16C.P2 World Clock era, or with the Adept of Ages (16th Century-P.2) title equipped.
